title: Kissing Cat Emoji 😽 Meaning: Smooches, Feline Style
description: 😽 is a cat with closed eyes and puckered lips. It sends a sweet, playful kiss to partners, friends and pets. See examples and how it compares with 😘.
summary: The 😽 kissing cat emoji shows a cat with closed eyes and puckered lips. It sends a kiss in a sweet, playful way and is used for goodnight messages, thanks, and affection toward partners, friends, family, and pets. It is gentler and less romantic than 😘.
meaning: A kiss from a cat is a small, affectionate thing, and that is the register 😽 works in. Where 😘 blows a kiss with a heart and can feel flirtatious, the kissing cat is closer to a peck on the cheek. People use it to say goodnight, to thank someone warmly, or to sign off a chat with fondness. Its cuteness lowers the stakes, so it is comfortable between friends and relatives as well as couples.

Cat owners have an obvious extra use. The emoji captions photos of nose boops, forehead kisses, and those moments when a cat presses its face into yours. It also stands for kissing the pet itself: 'give Luna a 😽 from me.' In pet-loving circles it is often aimed at the animal and not at the person receiving the message.

Among the cat faces it is one of the quieter ones. It has not been picked up for irony or memes, and it carries no double meaning. Couples who share a cat-themed pet name or inside joke sometimes adopt it as their private kiss. Otherwise, its meaning is exactly what it looks like, which makes it reliable when you want affection to read as innocent.

contexts.label: In texting
contexts.body: It closes conversations: 'night 😽' or 'thank you, you're the best 😽.' The feel is cozy. People who find the standard kiss faces too intense for friends use the cat as a workaround, because it is hard to mistake a puckered cartoon cat for a serious romantic advance.

contexts.label: From a partner or crush
contexts.body: Between partners it is everyday tenderness, the text equivalent of a quick kiss on the way out. From a crush it shows warmth but is ambiguous; some people send it to everyone they like. If it arrives with hearts or after flirting, treat it as a real kiss.

contexts.label: On pet accounts
contexts.body: Owners use it for photos of cats touching noses, grooming each other, or tolerating a human kiss. Commenters leave it to send love to someone's pet. Rescue pages add it to posts celebrating adoptions and reunions, where it stands for affection all around.

examples.meaning: A gentle goodnight kiss to end the conversation.
Grateful affection toward someone who did something kind.

examples.text: Give Pepper a kiss from her auntie 😽
examples.meaning: Sending love to a friend's cat.
A soft, affectionate note to a partner or close friend.

combos.meaning: A kiss with clear affection, common between partners and best friends.
Kisses for a pet, or from one cat lover to another.

confusedWith.difference: 😘 winks and blows a heart, which makes it flirtier and more common in romance. 😽 has no heart and both eyes closed, giving a quieter, cuter kiss that fits friends and family more easily.
😻 reacts to something lovely with heart-shaped eyes. 😽 performs an action, giving a kiss. Use heart eyes to admire and the kissing cat to show affection or say goodbye.
😚 is the human face with the same closed eyes and pucker, plus blushing cheeks. 😽 is its cat twin. The meanings match; the cat simply adds a playful, pet-friendly tone.

avoid: Do not send it to colleagues or acquaintances, because any kiss emoji can feel overly intimate outside close relationships.
Avoid it when you want to express serious romantic feeling, since its cuteness can make the message seem lighter than you intend.
design: The glyph is a cat's head with pointed ears and whiskers, eyes closed in curved lines, and a small puckered mouth. Fur is yellow or orange on most platforms. Some vendors draw the mouth as a tiny '3' shape and others as pursed lips, but none adds a heart, which distinguishes it from 😘.

faqs.q: What does 😽 mean from a girl?
faqs.a: It is a sweet, affectionate kiss. Girls commonly send it to close friends, family, and partners alike, so by itself it does not prove romantic interest. Look at how she texts other people and what else is in the message.

faqs.q: What does 😽 mean from a guy?
faqs.a: He is being affectionate and a bit soft. From a boyfriend it is a casual kiss. From a guy friend it is unusual enough that it may signal fondness, though some people just enjoy cat emojis.
It can be, but it is one of the least charged kiss emojis. Without hearts or flirty wording it reads as friendly warmth, similar to an 'x' at the end of a message.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😽 and 😗?
faqs.a: 😗 is a plain yellow kissing face with open eyes, and many people read it as whistling or awkwardness. 😽 has closed eyes and a cat's features, so it comes across as a real, affectionate kiss.
